_comment: Dev config for STT-enabled edge nodes. Requires the following env to be set before launching Hayabusa --dispatcher-only: HAYABUSA_WHISPER_BIN, HAYABUSA_WHISPER_MODEL. Optional: HAYABUSA_WHISPER_LANG, HAYABUSA_WHISPER_THREADS, HAYABUSA_STT_TIMEOUT_SEC, HAYABUSA_STT_RECORDINGS_ROOT, HAYABUSA_STT_MAX_AUDIO_MB, HAYABUSA_STT_PROD_MODE.
